content: VENTUNO Q first contact gotcha: a fresh board with official barrel power + LED matrix lit shows NOTHING on USB (no lsusb, no kernel event, no adb) and takes no DHCP lease until first-run setup (password) is completed on a monitor+keyboard. After setup it enumerates as USB 2341:007a (adb needs a udev rule for vendor 2341) and SSHes as user arduino. Factory OS: Ubuntu 24.04, kernel 6.8.0-qcom, GRUB EFI; eMMC 59.3G has A/B only for boot firmware, Linux is single-slot efi/persist(30M)/system.

Operator decisions 2026-11-01: CultureOS base is Yocto (issue #3, meta-cultureos), not a layer on factory Ubuntu; OS will live on NVMe and OTA (OSTree via meta-updater/qcom-distro-sota, rollback via OSTree deployments, boot-firmware A/B untouched) is deferred until the NVMe is installed; Tailscale enrollment is a manual one-time tailscale up by the operator, no auth key in the image. Frame: devague ventuno-q-cultureos-ota.
